-- ============================================= -- Author: <Author,,Name> -- Create date: <Create Date,,> -- Description: <Description,,> -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[AG_Balance_Void_Row] @T_ID int
AS SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY NORMAL
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION
declare @SumPure FLOAT,@BS_Type INT,@i INT,@IM_ID INT,@D_Valid NVARCHAR(50),@TB_ID INT , @Bill_Num INT ,@ST_T_ID INT,@ST_ID INT,@ST_QTY NUMERIC(18,2),@ST_F INT,@ST_T INT,@isDepended INT ,@AG_ID INT,@TR_ID INT , @TRAN_ID INT,@SB_T_ID INT
SELECT @BS_Type = BsType_ID , @AG_ID = AG_ID , @TB_ID = Table_ID , @Bill_Num = S_Bill_Pr_ID FROM Agents_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID = @T_ID
IF @BS_Type = 1 BEGIN SELECT @SumPure = ISNULL(SUM(T_Price),0) FROM SB_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID END IF @BS_Type = 7 or @BS_Type = 9 BEGIN SELECT @SumPure = ISNULL(SUM(Total),0) FROM Pch_Details WHERE Pch_T_ID = @T_ID END
--***************************************************
IF @BS_Type = 1 BEGIN SELECT @isDepended = isDepended FROM Agents_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID = @T_ID
IF @isDepended = 1 BEGIN EXEC [SB_Contents_Structers_Remove] @T_ID END
UPDATE SB_Contents SET isDepended = 0 where Bill_T_ID = @T_ID
--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From SB_Contents_WithStore_V WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID --WHILE @i IS NOT NULL --BEGIN --SELECT @IM_ID = IM_ID,@D_Valid=D_Vaild,@ST_ID=ST_ID,@ST_QTY=ST_QTY FROM SB_Contents_WithStore_V WHERE T_ID = @i --EXEC Inc_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY --SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From SB_Contents_WithStore_V WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i --END
IF (SELECT TB_Auto_Print FROM Sys_Features WHERE T_ID = (SELECT T_ID FROM Sys_Model)) = 1 BEGIN
DECLARE @Desc NVARCHAR(MAX) SET @Desc = CONCAT(' إلغاء فاتورة رقم ',@Bill_Num, CHAR(13), CHAR(10), ' طاولة : ',(SELECT TOP 1 T_Name FROM Tables WHERE TB_ID = @TB_ID))
INSERT INTO TB_AutoPrint_tmp (T_ID, Notes, Printer_IP) SELECT 0, @Desc, GP.Printer_IP FROM GM_Printer_V GP JOIN IM_Menu IM ON GP.GM_ID = IM.GM_ID WHERE IM.IM_ID IN (SELECT IM_ID FROM SB_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID) AND GP.Printer_IP IS NOT NULL;
END
GOTO FINAL_
END
IF @BS_Type = 2 BEGIN UPDATE EXP_Details SET isDepended = 0 where IMEX_T_ID = @T_ID GOTO FINAL_ END
IF @BS_Type IN (3,4) BEGIN Update Treasury_Balance_MV SET isVoid = 1,Balance = NULL WHERE AGBalance_T_ID = @T_ID GOTO FINAL_ END
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF @BS_Type = 7 or @BS_Type = 9 BEGIN UPDATE Pch_Details SET isDepended = 0 where Pch_T_ID = @T_ID --SELECT @i = min(T_id) From Pch_Details WHERE Pch_T_ID = @T_ID --WHILE @i IS NOT NULL --BEGIN --SELECT @IM_ID = IM_ID,@D_Valid=D_Vaild,@ST_ID=ST_ID,@ST_QTY=ST_QTY FROM Pch_Details WHERE T_ID = @i --EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY --EXEC ReCount_IM_Main_COST @IM_ID --SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From Pch_Details WHERE Pch_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i --END END
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF @BS_Type = 8 BEGIN UPDATE IMEX_Details SET isDepended = 0 where IMEX_T_ID = @T_ID --SELECT @i = min(T_id) From IMEX_Details WHERE IMEX_T_ID = @T_ID --WHILE @i IS NOT NULL --BEGIN --SELECT @IM_ID = IM_ID,@D_Valid=D_Vaild,@ST_ID=ST_ID,@ST_QTY=ST_QTY FROM IMEX_Details WHERE T_ID = @i --EXEC Inc_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY --SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From IMEX_Details WHERE IMEX_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i --END END ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- IF @BS_Type = 10 OR @BS_Type = 11 BEGIN UPDATE Rtn_Contents SET isDepended = 0 where Bill_T_ID = @T_ID --IF @BS_Type = 10 BEGIN EXEC Rtn_Contents_UPDATE_DEPENDED @T_ID END --SELECT @i = min(T_id) From Rtn_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID --WHILE @i IS NOT NULL --BEGIN --SELECT @IM_ID = IM_ID,@D_Valid=D_Vaild,@ST_ID=ST_ID,@ST_QTY=ST_QTY FROM Rtn_Contents WHERE T_ID = @i --IF @BS_Type = 10 BEGIN EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY END --ELSE BEGIN EXEC Inc_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY END --SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From Rtn_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i --END END --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- IF @BS_Type = 12 --Store_Trans BEGIN UPDATE Store_Trans_Details SET isDepended = 0 where B_T_ID = @T_ID --SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From Store_Trans_Details WHERE B_T_ID = @T_ID --WHILE @i IS NOT NULL --BEGIN --SELECT @IM_ID = IM_ID,@D_Valid=D_Vaild,@ST_F = ST_F_ID,@ST_T = ST_To_ID,@ST_QTY = ST_QTY FROM Store_Trans_Details WHERE T_ID = @i
----EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_T,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY --EXEC Inc_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_F,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY
--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From Store_Trans_Details WHERE B_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i --END END ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF @BS_Type = 13 OR @BS_Type = 18 -- FRM_ITEM BEGIN
UPDATE FRM_Details SET isDepended = 0 where FRM_T_ID = @T_ID
--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From FRM_Details WHERE FRM_T_ID = @T_ID --WHILE @i IS NOT NULL --BEGIN
--SELECT @IM_ID=IM_ID,@D_Valid=D_Vaild,@ST_ID = ST_ID,@ST_QTY = ST_QTY --FROM FRM_Details WHERE T_ID = @i --EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY --SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From FRM_Details WHERE FRM_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i --END
--2++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
UPDATE FRM_Contents_Details SET isDepended = 0 where Bill_T_ID = @T_ID
--SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From FRM_Contents_Details WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID --WHILE @i IS NOT NULL --BEGIN
--SELECT @IM_ID=IM_ID,@D_Valid='',@ST_ID = ST_ID,@ST_QTY = ST_QTY FROM FRM_Contents_Details WHERE T_ID = @i --EXEC Inc_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY --SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From FRM_Contents_Details WHERE Bill_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i --END
END
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF @BS_Type = 17 BEGIN UPDATE InSale_Details SET isDepended = 0 where InSale_T_ID = @T_ID --SELECT @i = min(T_id) From InSale_Details WHERE InSale_T_ID = @T_ID --WHILE @i IS NOT NULL --BEGIN --SELECT @IM_ID = IM_ID,@D_Valid=D_Vaild,@ST_ID=ST_ID,@ST_QTY=ST_QTY FROM InSale_Details WHERE T_ID = @i --EXEC Inc_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY --SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From InSale_Details WHERE InSale_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i --END END -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF @BS_Type = 35 BEGIN UPDATE OutSale_Details SET isDepended = 0 where OutSale_T_ID = @T_ID --SELECT @i = min(T_id) From OutSale_Details WHERE OutSale_T_ID = @T_ID --WHILE @i IS NOT NULL --BEGIN --SELECT @IM_ID = IM_ID,@D_Valid=D_Vaild,@ST_ID=ST_ID,@ST_QTY=ST_QTY FROM OutSale_Details WHERE T_ID = @i --EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY --SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From OutSale_Details WHERE OutSale_T_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i --END END -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FINAL_:
exec [Agents_Balance_MV_Cancel] @T_ID = @T_ID, @User_ID = 1, @Reason = 'إلغاء المعاملة'
UPDATE Agents_Balance_MV SET SB_isOpen = 0 ,isPause = NULL , --Pure = @SumPure , Order_isDeleverd = 1 ,isVoid = 1,Balance = NULL WHERE T_ID =@T_ID
IF @TB_ID > 0 BEGIN IF ( SELECT COUNT(T_ID) FROM Tables_Bills_NotPied_V WHERE Table_ID = @TB_ID ) = 0 BEGIN UPDATE TABLES SET isbusy = 0 , TB_ORDER_CODE = NULL WHERE TB_ID = @TB_ID END END
SELECT @SB_T_ID = Receipt_Tran_ID FROM Agents_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID = @T_ID IF @BS_Type = 3 BEGIN UPDATE Agents_Balance_MV SET isPied = 0 WHERE T_ID = @SB_T_ID END
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From Agents_Balance_MV_RCT WHERE Receipt_Tran_ID = @T_ID WHILE @i IS NOT NULL BEGIN EXEC [Agents_Balance_MV_RCT_VOID] @i --Update Agents_Balance_MV SET isVoid = 1 WHERE T_ID = @i --Update Treasury_Balance_MV SET isVoid = 1,Balance = NULL WHERE AGBalance_T_ID = @i SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From Agents_Balance_MV_RCT WHERE Receipt_Tran_ID = @T_ID AND T_ID > @i END -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--if @T_ID <> 0 and (SELECT BsType_ID FROM Agents_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID = @T_ID) = 3 --BEGIN exec [AG_Balance_Update_Pied] @T_ID END
COMMIT END TRY
BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 raiserror ('DB ERROR (AG_Balance_Void_Row)',16,1,'خطأ') ROLLBACK END CATCH

-- ============================================= -- Author: <Author,,Name> -- Create date: <Create Date,,> -- Description: <Description,,> -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SB_Contents_Structers_Remove] @Bill_T_ID INT AS BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION
DECLARE @i INT ,@j INT, @Valid_ST NVARCHAR(50),@ST_QTY numeric(18, 3),@IM_ID INT,@U_ID INT,@SB_Cont_T_ID INT,@ST_ID INT,@QYT NUMERIC(18,2)
SELECT @j = min(T_ID) From [SB_Contents] WHERE Bill_T_ID = @Bill_T_ID WHILE @j IS NOT NULL BEGIN
SELECT @IM_ID = IM_ID , @U_ID = U_ID , @SB_Cont_T_ID = T_ID , @ST_ID = ST_ID , @QYT = QTY FROM SB_Contents WHERE T_ID = @j
SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From [SB_Contents_Structers] WHERE SB_Cont_T_ID = @SB_Cont_T_ID WHILE @i IS NOT NULL BEGIN
SELECT @IM_ID=Struct_ID,@Valid_ST='',@ST_ID = ST_ID,@ST_QTY = ST_QTY FROM [SB_Contents_Structers] WHERE T_ID = @i EXEC Inc_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@Valid_ST,@ST_QTY SELECT @i = min(T_ID) From [SB_Contents_Structers] WHERE SB_Cont_T_ID = @SB_Cont_T_ID AND T_ID > @i
END
SELECT @j = min(T_ID) From [SB_Contents] WHERE Bill_T_ID = @Bill_T_ID AND T_ID > @j END
DELETE FROM SB_Contents_Structers WHERE SB_Cont_T_ID IN (SELECT T_ID FROM SB_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @Bill_T_ID)
COMMIT END TRY
BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 raiserror('[SB_Contents_Structers_Remove]',16,1,'خطأ') ROLLBACK END CATCH
